title: diagnose-attention-bottlenecks
summary: Diagnose the next attention-kernel bottleneck after IO reduction using evidence about HBM traffic, work ownership, parallelism, scalar work, asynchronous scheduling and precision. Produce a bounded optimization hypothesis and correctness-first verification plan; do not infer current library support or NPU portability from GPU papers.
